profile.tagline: Building intelligent systems with LLMs, agents and production ML.
profile.headline: Building production AI with
profile.summary: AI/ML Engineer specialising in large language models, agentic workflows and retrieval-augmented generation. I design evaluation-first AI systems — guardrails, hallucination detection and observability built in — and ship them as containerised, production-ready services.
profile.longSummary: I'm a Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) graduate from Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering, Nagpur, working at the intersection of applied machine learning and production software engineering. My focus is the unglamorous half of AI that decides whether a system survives contact with real users: evaluation harnesses, guardrails, retrieval quality, drift monitoring and reproducible deployment. I've shipped 23 public projects spanning multi-agent security operations, self-healing RAG pipelines, LLM guardrail gateways and explainable financial intelligence — each built as a service, not a notebook.

availability.label: Available for AI/ML roles
availability.detail: Open to full-time AI/ML Engineer and LLM Engineer opportunities — remote or relocating.

experience.summary: Building modular Python backends and hardening the API layer behind internal products.
highlights: Engineered RESTful APIs in Python, improving backend maintainability through modular application design and structured request/response validation.
Optimised debugging and testing workflows, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve implementation and data-quality issues efficiently.
Moved validation to the service boundary so malformed payloads fail fast instead of reaching downstream consumers.

experience.summary: Evaluated and improved LLM output quality against structured rubrics, and cleaned the datasets behind them.
highlights: Evaluated LLM responses against quality guidelines, identifying recurring error patterns and improving response relevance and accuracy by 30%.
Validated structured and unstructured datasets, performing root-cause analysis to improve annotation consistency and AI evaluation quality.
Codified reviewer disagreements into a shared rubric, making evaluation results reproducible across annotators.

experience.summary: Turned raw operational records into analysis-ready datasets and surfaced the anomalies hiding in them.
highlights: Processed and analysed 10,000+ records using Python, ensuring high-quality, consistent datasets for downstream analytics.
Conducted exploratory data analysis to identify anomalies, improving dataset quality and supporting data-driven business decisions.
Automated recurring cleaning steps into reusable pipelines, removing manual preparation from the weekly reporting cycle.

highlights: Specialised in data science: machine learning, deep learning, statistics and data engineering.
Capstone work focused on applied LLM systems and retrieval-augmented generation.
Built and open-sourced 23 projects alongside coursework.
Science stream with mathematics and computer science as core subjects.
Thirteen years of schooling; first exposure to programming and mathematics.
